description: Declared mutants of v8-arch-event-sounds-impl (gyo.event_sounds in the framework, docs/framework/event-sounds.md; declaration docs/architecture/plans/event-sounds/contract-declaration.md section 3). Run from the repository root with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/event-sounds/scripts/event_sounds_mutations.json --build-dir build/target/_build/test. A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message. Test-case filters must not contain commas: doctest splits -tc on commas, and a filter that matches nothing passes. es-order-unchecked, es-events-not-object, es-string-type and es-number-type were added after review (tightening only, AGENTS.md section 14.4); removing the document's or an entry's is_object check is an equivalent mutant (RequireExactKeys refuses a non-object with the same path), so it is not listed. es-offset-overflow was added and es-offset-zero-clip redefined when the offset was tightened to give nothing for a non-finite result (user, 2026-11-04).

mutants.what: A repeated key is taken silently (the DOM keeps the last)
mutants.find:
if (!open.back().keys.insert(key).second)
                Fail("repeated key '" + key + "'", MemberPath(open.back().path, key));

mutants.what: An unknown top-level field is ignored
mutants.replace: for (const char* key : {"schema", "version", "animation_events_asset_id", "events"}) if (!document.contains(key)) Fail("missing field", "");

mutants.what: An unknown field of an event's entry is ignored
mutants.replace: for (const char* key : {"sound_asset_id", "sync_seconds", "gain"}) if (!entry.contains(key)) Fail("missing field", path);

mutants.what: An entry without gain is read with a default gain
Another schema is read
Another version is read as version 1
A version written as a float (1.0) counts as 1
An empty animation_events_asset_id is accepted
An empty events object is accepted
mutants.find: if (sounds.sounds.empty()) return invalid("events is a nonempty object", "events");

mutants.what: An empty event name is accepted
An empty sound_asset_id is accepted
A negative sync_seconds is accepted
A non-finite sync_seconds is accepted (structure)
Gains are not checked with Engine's IsValidGain
A gain above kMaxGain is clamped to it instead of refused
An event name in no clip is bound
Only the first clip's events are searched
sync_seconds is not compared with the sound's length
A sync point equal to the sound's length is refused
A sound the caller does not know is bound
An entry that fails binding is dropped and the rest is bound
The caller is asked by event name instead of sound asset id
The offset ignores the stretch of the clip over the action
mutants.find: const double offset = eventSeconds * (actionSeconds / clipSeconds) - syncSeconds;

mutants.what: The sync point is added instead of subtracted
mutants.find: const double offset = eventSeconds * (actionSeconds / clipSeconds) - syncSeconds;
mutants.replace: const double offset = eventSeconds * (actionSeconds / clipSeconds) + syncSeconds;

mutants.what: A clip without a positive length gives an offset (the clip's length is not checked; since the result check, a zero length alone is caught there, so the mutant drops the whole check and a negative length shows it)
Non-finite arguments give an offset
The guard's core positive list takes GYO::AudioBackendSDL (SDL) along with Engine's mixer
GYO::Model hands its JSON library on PUBLIC (Engine's CMake, changed only while the mutant runs); the configure-time link check stops the core reaching it through GYO::Model
mutants.find: target_link_libraries(gyo_model PUBLIC GYO::Engine GYO::Math PRIVATE nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)

mutants.what: Structure with repeated or unordered names is accepted (Find relies on the order)
events is not checked to be an object
A string field is read without checking its type
mutants.find: if (!value.is_string()) Fail(std::string(what) + " is a string", path);

mutants.what: A number field is read without checking its type
mutants.find: if (!value.is_number()) Fail(std::string(what) + " is a number", path);

mutants.what: A result that overflowed to infinity is given as an offset
